fields.FIR_Description: As per the complaint recorded on 2025-11-02, Tamilarasan Palanisamy reported that a shop near Vaigai Layout Market Road was occupied without a valid agreement and the occupant refused to leave. The time of the incident was given as 12:55 on 2025-11-01. The complaint was lodged by Gopal Gopal (9000000034) on behalf of Tamilarasan Palanisamy, whose contact number is given as 9000000023. Harish Babu (9000000422) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. The complainant alleged that Logesh Subramani may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000233. The complainant mentioned physical documents.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Occupant reportedly refused to vacate despite repeated requests.
